[IDSP.7.9] Errors are [NCBK.7.5]'s. The dispatcher adds two
defensive refusals no compiled program reaches, each `DS_ERR_INVAL`:
a negative TTL, and a value that is not JSON text. The
interpreted path makes them where the author's value is
still visible, in the cache-set adapter, and the
ahead-of-time slot makes them on entry, so the two paths
agree on identical input.
